caption: The drawing depicts a wooden desk with a reddish-brown, mahogany appearance. The desk has four short, rounded, and turned legs with brass or gold-colored feet. The front of the desk features three large drawers, each with two circular metallic knobs, and the center drawer appears slightly open. Above these drawers, there is a flip-down or pull-out writing surface with a green felt or fabric inlay. Behind this writing surface, there is a compartmentalized hutch with several small cubby holes, a pair of columns holding up pigeonhole slots, three small drawers on each side with round knobs, and two standing books placed upright between the columns. The top surface of the desk is flat and overhangs slightly, and there are two brass or gold-colored handles on either side of the pull-out writing surface. The drawing is centered on a plain, cream-colored background, and the illustration is detailed, showing the wood grain, metallic hardware, and construction elements of the desk.
title: Mahogany Desk
